title: feat(comments): a member resolves any thread they can read and deletes their own comments, through two server doors (#36186, #36191)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuQDMVvYbduXkDz6CEaA8Q1G)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUH1jEKbDzYRc4nghq

Fixes #36186
Fixes #36191

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/plugin-audit`'s `AuditPlugin` mounts two new HTTP routes, `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution` and `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id`, and the resolution stamp reads a system write's `provenance.attributedUserId`. `@objectstack/core`'s `OwnRowDeleteDoor` adds the optional `refuseRemoval(row, engine, context)` (step 7, after the owner check). `@object-ui/react`'s `DiscussionContextValue` adds the optional `ownCommentDeletesOnly`; `@object-ui/plugin-detail`'s `RecordCommentsData` adds the optional `ownDeletesOnly`, which `RecordCommentThreadProps['comments']` may carry; `@object-ui/core`'s affordance-to-grant map adds the row `feedCommentDeleteOwn`. Nothing existing is removed or re-typed.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 普通成员现在能给**任何**自己看得到、也能在上面发评论的评论串点对勾（标成已解决），也能恢复。以前只能点自己发起的串，别人发起的只有管理员能点。点了以后「已由 某某 解决」写的是点的人。这就是你 13:25Z 的裁定 A（能看记录就能解决，门槛和发评论一样）真正生效。
- 普通成员现在能**删自己的评论**。以前成员的「更多」里只有编辑。删别人的评论还是不行，能编辑记录也不行；管理员照旧。
- **自己的评论下面已经有回复（不管是谁回的，自己回的也算），就不能删**（可以改文字）。原因：平台删一条顶层评论时会把下面的回复各自变成独立的串，等于改动了别人的评论，这不符合你 21:59Z 的裁定（别人的评论删不了）。座位核过，认为这是裁定本身的结论，不再单独问你。管理员有删除权限，删法和以前一样。
- 评论的文字照旧只有作者能改。平台的底线规则、删除权限一行没动：两个新的服务端入口各只做一件事（一个只改「已解决」，一个只删自己的那一行）。走原来的数据接口，成员改别人评论、改别人的「已解决」、删任何评论，仍然是 403。
- 只能看评论、不能发评论的人（比如只给了只读权限的外部成员），**点不了对勾**，控制台也不显示对勾。审核指出裁定 A 里同时写了「能看记录的人」和「和发评论同一道门槛」，座位定了按后者，较窄。普通成员都能发评论，所以对他们没有区别；能发评论的外部成员照样能点。
- 已知限制：删评论时「下面有没有回复」的检查和真正删除是两步。如果恰好在这一瞬间有人发了回复，这条回复会变成独立的串，和今天管理员用数据接口删评论时一样。平台的数据引擎没有「条件删除」可以把两步并成一步，套一层事务在默认隔离级别下也挡不住别的请求插进来的回复，所以先写明，不在这次改。

## What changes

**The resolution door** (`plugin-audit` `comment-routes.ts`, #36186)

- `PUT /api/v1/comments/:id/resolution`, body exactly `{ "resolved": boolean }`. Order: caller (the own-row doors' one composition, `ownRowDeleteCallerResolver`), anonymous `401`, held sign-in `403`, any query parameter or other body `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`, the comment read AS THE CALLER (object grant + organization wall + the comment read gate; unreadable and unknown both `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`), the posting gate (the security service's `canWriteObject('sys_comment', 'insert', caller)`: a caller who reads comments but may not post one is `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, a check that throws refuses, and a deployment with no security service has no posting gate either; ruling 7063285032 names "the same gate as posting a comment", contract review F1), a reply `400` (`refuseResolutionOnReply`, the data door's sentence), then a system write of `{ is_resolved }` alone by id, `attributedUserId` = caller, the caller's organization kept. Answers `200 { id, is_resolved, resolved_by, resolved_at }` read back as stored.
- `stampCommentResolution` (`comment-resolution.ts`): on a system write the resolver is `provenance.attributedUserId` (the audit writer's own read of the attribution), so `resolved_by` names the door's caller. A non-system write still stamps its session user; a system write with no attribution still stamps `null`.
- Untouched: `owner_only_writes`, `sys_comment_moderation`, `member_default`, the data door's resolve limb (#36104). No `sys_comment` update twin: a row policy cannot scope a column, so one would also admit a member's edit of a colleague's words, which ruling 7069889899 keeps author-only.

**The own-comment delete door** (same file, #36191)

- `DELETE /api/v1/comments/:id` on `@objectstack/core`'s shared own-row delete door; owner column `author_id`. Another member's comment `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, even for a record editor (the moderator's delete stays the data door's, behind the delete grant).
- Step 7, new in the kit: `OwnRowDeleteDoor.refuseRemoval`, asked after the owner check. The comment door's refuses a comment with any reply under it (a system read of `parent_id = id`), `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED`: `parent_id` is a lookup that clears on delete, so the removal would turn each reply into a thread of its own, a rewrite of other members' rows. The other three doors on the kit declare none and are unchanged. Known limit (contract review F2): the reply check and the removal are two engine calls and the data engine offers no conditional delete to join them (wrapping both in a transaction would not close it either: at the stores' default isolation another request's reply insert still lands between the probe and the delete), so a reply posted within that one request is promoted to a thread of its own, the same result as an administrator's data-door delete today; stated in the module doc.
- Both doors mount beside the unreact door (`mountCommentDoors`, renamed from `mountUnreactDoor`); one `warn` names all three routes when no HTTP server is registered. Ledger rows in `comment-route-ledger.ts` (`gap`: the console is the consumer, the SDK has no method), with their conformance test; `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` declares the module.

**Console** (`RecordDetailView`, `plugin-detail`, `react`, `core`)

- ✓ calls the resolution door and is offered on every thread, the viewer's and anyone else's, under the `sys_comment` create grant (the door's posting gate), wherever the rows store resolution; it no longer depends on `updatesOthersComments`. The explain probe of a foreign `sys_comment` update stays, and gates Edit on someone else's comment alone.
- Delete: with the `sys_comment` delete grant, the data door as before (others' comments included where the viewer moderates). Without it, the new affordance row `feedCommentDeleteOwn` (`grant: 'create'`, as `feedReactionRemove`) hands Delete over, it calls the own-comment door, and the host sets `ownCommentDeletesOnly`: `CommentThread` and the legacy `CommentBody` then offer Delete on the viewer's own comments with no reply and on nobody else's, whatever `moderatesComments` says. So the panel offers exactly what the doors admit.
- `handleResolveComment`'s jsdoc says what the write is now (L2 S-D1 on #36178). `affordanceGrantMap-12082`: `handleResolveComment` is no longer a data-source write site (its row is gone); `feedCommentDeleteOwn` is in the grant table.

**Prose**: `plugin-detail.mdx` (Delete wording; ✓ on every thread; the own-comment door). The two unreleased notes of #36104 (`36071-comment-threads-resolved.md`) and #36178 (`36075-comments-resolved.md`) stay as written; the new changeset `36186-36191-comment-doors.md` ends with one sentence for each, naming the line it replaces.

## Why

Ruling 7063285032 (any reader may resolve) never reached a rank-and-file member: the row floor runs before the comment hook (L1-c HOLD 7068026256, readings in #36178). Ruling 7069889899 kept comment text author-only, which rules out loosening the floor for `update`, and added the own-comment delete (`member_default` may carry no delete bit, ADR-0090 D5). Shape agreed in the premise read and the seat's claims 7069978538 / 7069989751.

## Verification

- `plugin-security` `comment-doors.integration.test.ts` (16 cases, real kernel + `SecurityPlugin` with the shipped sets + `AuditPlugin` + the real caller resolution, SQLite, two plain `org_member` principals, an `org_admin` and two `org_external` principals with explicit grants): member resolves and reopens a colleague's thread (200, `resolved_by` = member, cleared on reopen); data door unchanged (member's `body`, `is_resolved`, `{ is_resolved, body }` on a colleague's comment all 403); reply 400; unreadable = unknown 404; anonymous 401, query and every malformed body 400; own delete 200; colleague's 403 and stays; own comment with a reply 409, root and reply unchanged; own reply 200; own comment on an unreadable record 404; an external who reads the thread but may not post is 403 on resolve and still reads the comment, an external who may post resolves (200); member's data-door delete of their own still 403; admin resolves through the data door (floor does not bind) and the comment rule still decides edits.
- `plugin-audit`: `comment-routes.test.ts` (mount, pre-engine answers, the write's exact shape and context; +4 for the posting gate: refused 403 with no write, a throwing check refuses, an unreadable comment still 404 before the gate, a poster resolves), `comment-resolution.test.ts` (+2: attribution stamps a system write; never outranks a session user), `comment-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`; unreact ledger unchanged. `core`: `own-row-delete-routes.test.ts` (+3: step 7 refuses before any removal, runs only after the owner check, resolving admits).
- UI: `RecordDetailView.commentsResolved-36075` also pins no ✓ for a viewer without the `sys_comment` create grant. `CommentsPanel.resolved-36075` (✓ on others' threads without the floor verdict; own-door Delete matrix), `RecordDetailView.commentsResolved-36075` (✓ → door URL and body, no data-source update; refused ✓; member without delete grant deletes through the door, none on others', none on own-with-reply; refused door delete), `RecordDetailView.feedCommentEditDelete-12268` (the no-delete-grant pin now asserts the door, plus own-with-reply). Local: app-shell comment/feed/discussion/reaction/explain RecordDetailView files + all of `plugin-detail` + `react` context: 437 files, 4067 passed.
- Typecheck: `plugin-audit`, `core`, `plugin-security` clean. `check-route-envelope`, `check-single-authz-resolver` green. `check-governed-merges --test` on the file list: not governed.
- Rig readings, CRM dev server (`objectstack dev --fresh`). Before: the #36178 hold readings at `a2dc85896` (reader and a record editor, both plain org members). After: this branch at `dd9f5571`; a fresh rig is `invite_only` now, so the admin creates both members through `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/create-user`, the reader with `viewer_readonly` and the record editor with `crm_sales_user`.

  | Reading | Before | After |
  |---|---|---|
  | Member resolves the admin's thread | data API `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` | door `200`, `resolved_by` = the member |
  | Member resolves a colleague's thread / reopens it | data API `403` | door `200` / `200`, `resolved_by` and `resolved_at` cleared |
  | Member resolves a reply | n/a | door `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` |
  | Member's data-API `is_resolved` on the admin's thread | `403` | `403` (unchanged) |
  | Record editor edits a member's comment (data API) | `403` | `403` (unchanged) |
  | Member edits the admin's comment | `403` | `403` (unchanged) |
  | Member deletes own comment, data API | `403` | `403` (unchanged) |
  | Member deletes own comment, door | n/a | `200 { deleted: true }` |
  | Member deletes a colleague's comment, door | n/a | `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` |
  | Member deletes own comment with a reply, door | n/a | `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED`, root and reply kept |
  | Colleague deletes that reply, door; member then deletes the root | n/a | `200`, then `200` |
  | Admin edits / resolves / deletes a member's comment (data API) | `200` | `200` / `200` / `200` (unchanged) |

  Rows left on the record afterwards: the admin's thread (resolved by the member), the record editor's thread (reopened); nothing else. Script and report: `build-seat1/36186-36191/rig/doors.cjs`, `doors-report.json` in the project files.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (eslint on the touched files: 0 errors.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (Two folded cards, one `Fixes` line each.)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 section is the maintainer's Chinese summary, as on this seat's other PRs.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## Follow-ups

- None filed. A "comment deleted" placeholder that would let an author remove a comment that has replies is a product question of its own (needs a stored marker), not in scope. Contract review F3 (the console asks the create grant for own-comment Delete while the door asks none) is left as is, consistent with `feedReactionRemove`.
